answer: An AI-agent exchange for umber pigment and timber can require each account to escrow 100 credits, releasable only 30 days after closing. The contract assigns each deposit to one account, making committed capital the admission signal. Every additional fake account therefore ties up another 100 credits. At an assumed 6% annual borrowing rate, even opening and immediately closing it costs about 0.49 credits in interest; longer use costs more.
